item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a credible 2024 Putin action showing genuine nuclear-risk reduction such as arms-control revival, de-alerting, test restraint, or a new non-use commitment. The available evidence points mostly in the opposite direction.","evidence":[{"title":"Executive Order Approving the Basic Principles of State Policy of the Russian Federation on Nuclear Deterrence","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-11-19","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/news/75598","summary":"Putin signed a new nuclear deterrence doctrine replacing the 2020 version. The text says it identifies threats to be neutralized by nuclear deterrence and specifies conditions for nuclear use. That is evidence of formalizing and potentially widening escalation space, not reducing existential risk.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Russia says it will change nuclear doctrine because of Western role in Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-09-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-will-change-nuclear-doctrine-due-to-wests-actions-in-ukraine-official-says-3596699","summary":"Reuters reported the doctrine change as a response to Western involvement in Ukraine. That frames the move as coercive escalation tied to wartime leverage, not risk reduction.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Answers by Vladimir Putin and Alexander Lukashenko to media questions","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74002","summary":"Putin said a tactical nuclear-weapons drill was “not about using these weapons” and “just routine work.” This is the strongest restraint-flavored evidence I found, but it is only rhetoric about an exercise, not a step that actually lowers nuclear risk.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Report: Russian army meeting / updated deterrence principles","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-12-16","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/75887","summary":"Putin said Russia had “specified” the principles for using nuclear weapons and kept non-strategic nuclear forces on constant alert with continued exercises. He also linked this to response against U.S. missile deployments. I’m keeping it because it directly informs the escalation-vs-restraint balance.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Answers by Vladimir Putin and Alexander Lukashenko to media questions","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74002","summary":"The “this is not about using these weapons” line is the closest thing to de-escalatory rhetoric I found in 2024.
